card.name: Digits inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A digit or ordinal ending that sits in the middle of a longer number, such as the 6 in 106 or the 7 in 1,677. It also fires on ordinals like 72nd, and mostly in the middle or end of the number rather than at its start.

modes.label: Middle digit of a count
modes.description: A digit inside a multi-digit number of patients, doses, or items.
modes.example: In controlled clinical trials involving 1,6<<7>>7 patients treated with nabumetone

modes.label: Digit in an ID or street number
modes.description: A digit or ordinal ending inside a street, section, or long ID number.

modes.label: Round number like 100 or 200
modes.description: A zero in a round number, or the word after it, in a count.
modes.example: Google says it ranks sites using more than 20<<0>> different signals.

card.writes: It leans toward Chinese and other unit-like words such as month, century and continents, and away from device units like rpm, MHz and mAh.
